_comment: theagent2 project-local settings. Generated by `theagent2 init`. Hooks are committed to the repo as shell wrappers; the runtime they invoke is globally installed. See docs/decisions/003-three-layer-content-model-and-role-catalog.md. The bpmn-tools plugin is pinned because the upfront-design pipeline (ADR-030) uses it for BPMN authoring (bpmn-dsl/bpmn-tools) and rendering (render-bpmn-to-svg). The theagent2 plugin is pinned to FALSE and that line is load-bearing (#1670): it is not a tool a skill invokes, it is a published SNAPSHOT of these same templates, so leaving it to the user scope puts a second and older copy of every skill and agent beside this project's own — a session then runs a different program from the one this checkout ships, and neither copy says which it is. Delete the false and the duplicate comes back silently.
